page.layout: One printed page on the scan: digitiser's cover sheet with e-rara logo, title block, and multilingual licence text. No printed text of the book itself. Everything here is the digitiser's cover and is left out.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not part of the printed book: e-rara.ch logo, Visual Library logo, and the usage notes in German, English, French and Italian are omitted. The bibliographic data on the cover (title, author, place and year, library shelf mark and persistent link) is not transcribed because it is the digitiser's catalogue information, not the printed page of the 1629 book. The scan shows no printed page number, running head, catchword or signature.
